payout_value_note: $100 per qualifying referral; maximum 5 referrals per household ($500)
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($100-$100 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Friend becomes a member and opens a Rewards Checking Account (online with promo code SHARE100, in person, or video chat) mentioning the referrer. Minimum $50 deposit in the new checking account to receive the gift.
catches: Membership in CommonWealth required. Valid for new members and new checking only; limit one new checking account per new member; minimum $50 deposit in checking to receive gift; subject to $100 fee for closing the account within 6 months; all new accounts verified by Chex Systems; members with an existing CommonWealth checking account are not eligible. Maximum 5 referrals per household. Offer cannot be combined with any other offer and is subject to cancellation without notice.

eligibility: Friend: becomes a CommonWealth member, opens a Rewards Checking Account with a minimum $50 deposit, uses promo code SHARE100 (or mentions referrer); valid for new members and new checking only
timing: Paid after the friend becomes a member and opens a Rewards Checking Account with the $50 minimum deposit; exact payout timing (days) not stated on the official page.
notes: Official referral program page (wealthcu.org/referral-program, fetched 2026-09-23): 'when they open a Rewards Checking Account, you BOTH earn $100!' FAQ confirms referrer receives the $100 gift when the friend becomes a member and opens a Rewards Checking Account. Cap: 'Maximum 5 referrals per household' = $500 referrer cap. Distinct from the CommonWealth $200 checking promo (R0641 rejected, R1041 rejected) - this is the standing refer-a-friend program. Eligibility: live/work in Santa Clara County or eligible counties/companies/family. [schema normalized 2026-09-23 from alternate referral format]
